text.text_excerpt: LOVE this place. Best hotdogs in town. So far I have tried the italian sausage (amazing) and the beef kabob (so good) with curry sauce. The curry sauce is incredible. Everything I've had so far has been wonderful, including the hummus. And the buns are the best (I cannot stand soggy, boring hot dog buns). The best part of this place is that everything tastes really fresh and wonderful. I'm sure the vegan and veggie options are great too, just can't get past craving the italian sausage and beef franks, etc. And the owners are awesome. Let's support this place, get them to hit a festival or two, and give back to small business owners in the FQ/Treme area.

This is one of my absolute favorite places to eat in the city. As a relatively new vegan they have lots of options for me and I have yet to be disappointed, aside from the fact that my food is gone and I want more! The falafel hot dogs are my favorite and the vegan buns are actually better than the non-vegan buns, according to my husband. He's not a vegan and loves the other hot dogs as much as I love the vegan ones. He tasted my bun and has decided to order the vegan bun from now on. The waffle fries are delicious too. The staff is amazing and the atmosphere nice and relaxing. Whether you're vegan or not this is THE place for hot dogs in New Orleans. Don't get me wrong, I love Dat Dog bu...

Take a walk through Louis Armstrong Park, then come visit Dreamy Weenies! I was excited to try this place on my first trip to New Orleans, as it seemed to have interesting vegan hot dog options. There are multiple sausage options (including falafel!) and the toppings are vegan, except for the meat chili. I really enjoyed the whole-wheat (but nice and soft) vegan bun. For about $10 you can get a very filling meal. I think my favorite was the red rice and beans topping! The guys in charge were super friendly and the place is very clean.
